metadata.title: Main Bhi Bharat ।Telangana Police Targeting Adivasi आदिवासी आरक्षण की लूट और पुलिस का ज़ुल्म
metadata.description:
The Telangana Police have been persecuting Adivasi residents and activists in the state's northern districts of Adilabad and Kumuram Bheem Asifabad claims many activists from the area. The police has released a list of Maoist sympathisers which has the names of adivasi students, lawyers and teachers including some adivasi residents. In this interview we speak one of these names, Sidam Vivekanand, who is a lawyer in Hyderabad High Court. 

He says police is harassing him and other activists who raise voice of tribal rights.
